messages.subject: Project Willow - IBR scope and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Robert,

We've agreed the IBR scope with the Bank: short-term liquidity, integrity of the 13-week model, FY26-28 base/downside case, and deliverability of the restructuring. We'll deliver to the Bank by 10 April. We'll need data room access and a management session week commencing 9 March.

Duncan Reeves
Partner, Restructuring Advisory | Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
